description: One Codex turn the model refuses as too long (shape from source; to be replaced by the live recording): codex-acp 2.2.2 maps Codex's contextWindowExceeded to context_exhausted and sends an AIR client end_turn with a sessionFailure of category limit, actions ["new_session"], as a session_info_update and in the response's _meta. The client must end the turn TooLong, keep the text, and log no warning

note: shape from source; to be replaced by the live recording. The policy is context_exhausted's in codex-acp 2.2.2 (category limit, actions new_session); the title is Codex's ContextWindowExceeded text.

sessionFailure.title: Codex ran out of room in the model's context window. Start a new thread or clear earlier history before retrying.
